description: This file defines a class 'perf_postgres' for performance monitoring and tuning specific to PostgreSQL databases within the ADOdb PHP library. It includes SQL queries for database stats, cache configurations, and methods for table optimization and query explanation.

classes.name: perf_postgres
classes.description: A class for PostgreSQL performance monitoring and tuning that extends 'adodb_perf' with database-specific SQL queries, cache settings, and optimization methods.

methods.name: optimizeTable
methods.description: Optimizes a specified table using VACUUM commands with low or high modes.

methods.name: Explain
methods.description: Generates an EXPLAIN plan for a given SQL query, optionally filtering for partial matches.
